name: STAR Geometry — separation, position angle and offset on the sphere
summary: Angular separation, position angle and offset point for directions on the sphere, accurate from 1e-12 deg to the antipode; agrees with ERFA and astropy to 3e-14 deg on 600 pairs and refuses out-of-range angles.
reference: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, Example 17.a: Arcturus (213.9154, +19.1825) and Spica (201.2983, -11.1614) are 32.7930 deg apart
reference_observed: 32.79303 deg, within 2.7e-5 deg of the printed value (printed to 1e-4)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees in and out; position angle from North through East; output ranges stated
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; undefined position angle returned as 0 and documented; no iteration
